Terminus's first Seldon Crisis against the periphery kingdoms.

How First Crisis connects

  • Location: Terminus — The First Crisis breaks on Terminus.
  • Character: Salvor Hardin — Hardin solves the First Crisis without firing.
  • Location: Anacreon — Anacreon's threat is the First Crisis.

What is First Crisis?

The First Crisis is the moment neighboring Anacreon threatens Terminus and Salvor Hardin answers with politics instead of the Encyclopedia's quiet.

Key threads lead to Terminus, Salvor Hardin and Anacreon.
